description: Get compact peak facts and route IDs. Example input: {"slug":"ben-nevis"}. Optionally request access, huts, seasons, hazards or provenance sections. For fact questions search may already suffice. For current weather use get_weather; for hut booking information use get_huts. Research is not live availability.

sections.description: Omit for a compact overview, route IDs, season and notices. Request only sections needed.

slug.description: Peak slug returned by search, for example mont-blanc.
